effects.target: that person or a member of their immediate family
effects.persistence: one (1) year after eye contact is broken

evidence.locator: Any time an individual makes eye contact with SCP-023, either that person or a member of their immediate family will die exactly one (1) year after eye contact is broken.

effects.trigger: not contained in a setting that at least superficially resembles a "crossroads"

evidence.locator: If not contained in a setting that at least superficially resembles a "crossroads", SCP-023 will phase through walls to get to the nearest suitable location, incinerating all materials it passes through.
